_meta.adjudication_note: This map is the HAND-NAMED backbone. The graph builder computes DATA-DERIVED clusters independently and reconciles them against this map — disagreements are surfaced as signal, never auto-resolved.

complexes.name: AI Compute Complex
complexes.rationale: The physical layer of AI: compute silicon, memory, datacenter infrastructure, and the power/grid buildout feeding it. Co-move as a risk-on cluster driven by AI capex cycles. Semis lead, power-grid/nuclear are the lagging infrastructure tail.

complexes.name: Software & Cloud
complexes.rationale: Enterprise software and cloud platforms: longer-duration growth assets that benefit from declining rates and expanding AI monetization. Tend to lag semis into risk-off and recover faster in early risk-on re-entries.

complexes.name: Healthcare & Biotech Defensive
complexes.rationale: Healthcare is the textbook defensive: relatively inelastic revenues, low beta, inverse correlation to growth/semis in late-cycle/risk-off regimes. Biotech adds speculative volatility within the cluster but the sector-ETF leg anchors defensive character. GLP-1/obesity is an idiosyncratic within-sector growth story.

complexes.name: Consumer Staples Defensive
complexes.name_zh: 消费必需品防御性复合体
complexes.rationale: Classic late-cycle defensive rotation destination. Pricing power, inelastic demand, high dividend yield. Inverse to discretionary and tech in vol-regime transitions. The basket 'defensives' aggregates this cluster at a higher level.

complexes.name: Energy & Commodities Complex
complexes.name_zh: 能源与大宗商品复合体
complexes.rationale: Energy and materials move on commodity price cycles driven by supply/demand and USD regime. Mixed risk_sign: oil/energy leads risk-on in mid-cycle but gold/defensives metals hedge risk-off. The cluster is coherent as 'real-asset / inflation-hedge' complex even though intra-cluster correlations are regime-dependent.

complexes.name: Financials & Rate Sensitives
complexes.name_zh: 金融与利率敏感复合体
complexes.rationale: Banks and financials benefit from steeper yield curves and strong credit cycles (risk_on) but invert sharply in credit stress / yield curve inversion (risk_off). Rate-sensitive: strong lead-lag relationship with TLT. Fintech is a growth hybrid within the cluster.

complexes.name: Long-Duration Growth & Real Estate
complexes.name_zh: 长久期成长与房地产复合体
complexes.rationale: REITs and utilities are textbook long-duration assets: high dividend yield, bond-like behavior, inversely correlated with interest rates. Cluster together in risk-off/falling-rate regimes. Utilities have additional defensive character; REITs add credit-spread sensitivity.

complexes.name: Short-Duration Value & Industrials
complexes.name_zh: 短久期价值与工业复合体
complexes.rationale: Cyclical value names: industrials, materials, and domestic-facing businesses that benefit from nominal GDP acceleration and infrastructure spend. Shorter duration than software/growth; re-rate faster in early-cycle upturns. Defense is idiosyncratic but co-moves with industrials capex.
